items.title: Actual PBPS reflected conditional resolvents have the ordinary weak Laplacian

items.statement: For actual source V/alpha/beta/eta, construct genuine common augmentation R/S and exact reflected conditional laws. For every y, retain the true positive integrable C2 W_y and original dense closable compact smooth gradient D_y before epsilon/input. Every epsilon>0 and actual f in L2(S_y) has u in that same closure domain, the full variational and ordinary weak-gradient identities, genuine local volume L2 of u/G/k_y, locally integrable squared norm of k_y, and for all C2 compact phi the legal ordinary volume distribution identity integral u Delta phi = integral k_y phi, where k_y=epsilon u+inner(gradient W_y,G)-f. Reflected/RGO laws and scales remain distinct.
assumptions: E has the same real finite-dimensional Hilbert/Borel/full-space structure, including dimension zero. V is C2 with all-point/all-direction alpha I<=Hess V<=beta I, alpha,beta NNReal, 0<alpha<=beta; eta>0 and beta eta<=1.

The Gibbs/Gaussian augmentation, common Markov R/S, disintegration R, reflection S_y=(2x-y)#R_y, and true reflected W_y(u)=V((y+u)/2)+norm(u-y)^2/(8eta) are derived. Each selected S_y is precisely volume.tilted(-W_y), with positive integrable partition and C2 W_y.

For every y there is one original dense closable exact compact smooth gradient D_y with closed closure, fixed before epsilon and forcing. Every epsilon>0 and genuine f in L2(S_y) has one u/G serving all ordinary tests and compact sets. Existence is fiberwise; no joint measurable solution selection in y is concluded.

formulae.label: Actual PBPS reflected conditional resolvents have the ordinary weak Laplacian
formulae.tex: S_y=(2x-y)_\#R_y=Z_y^{-1}e^{-W_y}du,\quad W_y(u)=V((y+u)/2)+\|u-y\|^2/(8\eta);\quad\Delta u=\varepsilon u+\langle\nabla W_y,\overline D_yu\rangle-f\quad\text{in distributions}.

obligations.label: Actual same-solution ordinary distribution equation and local L2
Local H2, global operator core and Bochner (remaining)
Poincare/BL, main results and actual-input cost composition (remaining)

Full existing variational and ordinary weak-gradient identities retained. Actual PBPS R/S/reflected law and fixed fiber D before epsilon/input. No local H2, global generator core/Bochner, Poincare/BL, centered epsilon limit, noncompact constant/linear domains, measurable y-selection, SPHMC Hessian lower/full4.1 or complete paper/main/composition. TV never transfers unbounded expected cost.
